as_told.title: Dr. Venturelli face to face with the being at Hospital Regional

plain: In 1996, at the regional hospital in Varginha, Brazil, Italo Venturelli says he stood face to face in intensive care with a being "totally different from a human being," with a white face and red eyes, showing no pain, calm and, as he says, "highly intelligent, at least more than I was." Venturelli, the hospital's chief neurosurgeon, tells it first-hand in several interviews, saying a colleague, Marcos Vinícius, had stitched the being and that it "looked at me with a very beautiful look"; Michels repeats it on another episode, saying the meeting lasted four minutes, and if true it would mean a living non-human creature was treated in a Brazilian hospital.
